title: Move sign-in to OAuth
summary: Replace email + password with "Sign in with Google / GitHub", keep existing accounts, and delete the password reset flow.
author: Claude

tldr.what: Add OAuth sign-in, link it to existing accounts by verified email, then remove passwords.
tldr.why: 34% of support tickets are password resets, and we store password hashes we don't need.
tldr.ask: Pick the providers and what happens to accounts whose email doesn't match.

decisions.question: Which providers should we offer?
decisions.context: Each one needs an app registration and a few lines of config.

options.label: Google
options.detail: Most of our users have a Gmail address.

options.label: Apple
options.detail: Required only if we ship an iOS app.

decisions.why: Google and GitHub cover almost everyone and cost nothing.

decisions.question: What if an OAuth email doesn't match any account?

options.label: Create a new account
options.detail: Simple; some people may end up with two accounts.

decisions.why: Duplicates can be merged later from the admin page; blocking sign-in loses people.

plan.title: Register the OAuth apps
plan.detail: Google Cloud and GitHub developer settings; secrets go in the vault.

plan.title: Add the OAuth callback
plan.detail: One route that exchanges the code, verifies the email and finds or creates the account.

plan.title: New sign-in screen
plan.detail: Two buttons, the old form behind a "Use password" link for two weeks.

plan.title: Remove passwords
plan.detail: After two weeks: drop the form, the reset flow and the password_hash column.

plan.title: Tell users
plan.detail: Banner on the sign-in page and one email before passwords go away.

diagrams.title: Sign-in after the change
diagrams.caption: New parts in blue, changed in amber, removed dashed.

after.text: Password form, hidden behind a link for 2 weeks

risks.text: Users who signed up with an email they no longer own get locked out.
risks.mitigation: Keep the password link for two weeks and email everyone first.

risks.text: Google's consent screen review can take a few days.
risks.mitigation: Start step 1 today; GitHub works without review.

risks.text: Two accounts for the same person.
risks.mitigation: Merge tool in the admin page (already exists).

questions: Do we have numbers on how many accounts use non-Gmail addresses?
Who owns the Google Cloud project?
